g.text: one per user, holds the router key
child chats of that chat only
For each chat the engine makes a pass and puts it in the provider environment as SATURN_PASS
The saturn the task runs connects to the engine over the socket without a new engine, and only asks
The engine creates a chat that inherits the parent folder and lists it as a subagent of the parent task
The engine accepts only what the pass allows
A connection without a pass follows the Saturn permission rules like a chat you opened
Only the engine holds the router key and never hands it to a child or an outside caller
